topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well, now, ain't that a twist of the harvest wind. Yer friend told ye he wore the king's livery, went about collecting taxes and such, didn't he? Turns out, he's been ought ploughing his own fields same as you and me. Now, I reckon, such a thing can rattle the soul, catch ye off yer feet, make the ground feel less firm beneath yer boots. But ye know, the soil don’t lie. Neither does the sweat on yer brow. Perhaps yer friend’s just been sowing some wild seeds, looking for a bit of glory. Best to sift through the chaff, sit him down over a cup of cider, and ask him straight what's been ailing his heart. Might as well be a good harvest of truths by the time the last twig is gathered.
